# Petteri Helttula

> Portfolio of Petteri Helttula, a product designer based in Helsinki. He designs products and builds them with AI agents, guided by data and user testing.

## Main site

- [Portfolio](https://www.petu.design/): Selected work, other projects and a short about section.

## Case studies

- [KorisLab](https://www.petu.design/korislab/): An analytics tool for Finnish basketball that goes past the box score, across both Korisliiga leagues.
- [Peluutin](https://www.petu.design/peluutin/): A web app that helps junior coaches keep playing time fair and plan training in 3D, shaped with test coaches.
- [Helsinki Sports Map](https://www.petu.design/helsinki-sports-map/): Finding somewhere to exercise in Helsinki, and the easiest way to get there.
- [S-hävikki](https://www.petu.design/s-havikki/): A service concept for cutting food waste in grocery stores, starting with the staff who check the shelves.

## Other projects

- [Tahti](https://www.petu.design/tahti/): Paces dense text one word at a time.
- [Brio](https://www.petu.design/brio/): An iOS app that adds a little friction to social media (paused).
